maddeler.e: فِلَنْجَة or فَلَنْجَة or فَلِنْجَة • (filanja or falanja or falinja) f
maddeler.t: More direct borrowing of Sanskrit विडङ्ग (viḍaṅga), विडङ्गा (viḍaṅgā), which has also been borrowed via Persian برنگ (berang) as بِرَنْج (biranj).
g: baobarang, false black pepper (Embelia ribes; also Embelia tsjeriam-cottam syn. Embelia robusta)
